question: I want to know the preferences of customers who purchased the Google Navy Speckled Tee in December 2020. What other product was purchased with the highest total quantity alongside this item?
sql:
-- Find the single product purchased most frequently alongside "Google Navy Speckled Tee" in December 2020
WITH navy_purchases AS (
  SELECT 
    e.ecommerce.transaction_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` e
  WHERE e.event_name = 'purchase'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(e.items) AS i 
      WHERE i.item_name = 'Google Navy Speckled Tee'
    )
),
navy_items AS (
  SELECT 
    e.ecommerce.transaction_id,
    i.item_name,
    i.quantity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` e
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(e.items) AS i
  WHERE e.event_name = 'purchase'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND e.ecommerce.transaction_id IN (SELECT transaction_id FROM navy_purchases)
    AND i.item_name != 'Google Navy Speckled Tee'
)
SELECT 
  item_name,
  SUM(quantity) as total_quantity
FROM navy_items
GROUP BY item_name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1
